_comment: Identifiers this pack references but does not define: vanilla client entity
content, and content supplied by packs that are commonly loaded alongside
this one (Structura). The audit treats any reference that resolves to
nothing as a broken link unless it matches one of these patterns, so a
typo in a vanilla identifier is still caught while a legitimate borrow is
not. `*` matches any run of characters.
Adding a pattern is a claim that the game provides that identifier. Prefer
the narrowest pattern that covers the reference.
